mapper.select: SELECT u.id, u.username, u.nickname, u.role, uf.created_at AS followedAt FROM user_follow uf INNER JOIN sys_user u ON u.id = uf.followee_id WHERE uf.follower_id = #{userId} AND u.status = 1 ORDER BY uf.created_at DESC, uf.id DESC
